sources.title: Segmentation of Stamps in Documents - GitHub
sources.snippet: The segmentation of stamps in scanned documents is an essential task for automatic systems used in environments such as insurance companies. A significant amount of documents are processed daily, and the detection of stamps can be challenging due to their varied shapes, colors, and quality. sources.title: Document Segmentation Using Deep Learning in PyTorch
sources.snippet: Document Scanning is a background segmentation problem that can be solved using various methods. It is one of the extensively used applications of computer vision. In this article, we are considering Document Scanning as a deep learning-based semantic segmentation problem.
